label: Six work types
note: Type names are the labels from the assessment your team already took. This tool stores and reads results — it does not assess anyone. Swap this file to point the same engine at a different model.

levels.name: Genius
levels.desc: Energising — they gain fuel doing it

levels.name: Competency
levels.desc: Capable, but it costs them over time

levels.name: Frustration
levels.desc: Draining, and where they are genuinely weak

modes.name: Responsive
modes.desc: Reacts to something already in motion — a situation, an idea, a call for help

modes.name: Disruptive
modes.desc: Provokes change and pushes it onto other people

phases.name: Ideation
phases.desc: Naming the problem and producing an answer

phases.name: Activation
phases.desc: Judging what is worth doing and getting people to move

phases.name: Implementation
phases.desc: Supporting the work and carrying it to done

types.name: Wonder
types.desc: Sitting in the question — noticing something could be better before anyone asks

types.name: Invention
types.desc: Producing an answer from a blank page

types.name: Galvanizing
types.desc: Getting other people to move on it

types.name: Discernment
types.desc: Judging which answers are any good, on incomplete information

types.name: Enablement
types.desc: Responding to what others need, on their timeline

types.name: Tenacity
types.desc: Carrying it to done, at the standard promised

handoffs.name: Ideation → Activation
handoffs.symptom: Good thinking that nobody decides on, and nobody picks up.

handoffs.name: Activation → Implementation
handoffs.symptom: Decisions that get made with enthusiasm and then never land.

faces.name: Thriving
faces.line: Most of the tracked day sat in work that gives energy back.

faces.name: Heavy
faces.line: A real share of the day is spent in draining work. Sustainable for a day, not a month.

faces.name: Strained
faces.line: Past the line. This is a day built out of the work they are worst suited to.

observationTags.name: Carried a stretch
observationTags.desc: They were the reason a part of this worked

observationTags.name: Underused
observationTags.desc: Their genius was in the room and never asked for

observationTags.name: Got run over
observationTags.desc: They had something and the room moved past it

observationTags.name: Looked drained
observationTags.desc: This meeting was sitting in their frustration
